decision_rule: As in R2-A (copied so the rate is comparable). Corrected = the value adds a fact the cited page does not show, tags a judgement as stated, places a company-level fact at the plant, ties a posting or fact to the plant through a location shared by several sites (campus rule, consultation 10), misdates a posting, or the quote is not on the page (raw source checked first, incl. JSON-LD). Confirmed = the cited page, or for a multi-row claim a sibling row's page opened 2026-11-16, carries every additive clause. Not additive: limiting parentheticals, technical glosses, rubric labels, provenance labels, 'live 2026-11-16' stamps, and 'Not counted: ...' lists seen on the same board today. A substantive clause from a page that no row of that claim cites is additive. Opening lines: every clause carried by a stated row (or its page), ends in a 'you' question, no pitch.
